# amivisible

> Can AI see your site? Paste a URL, get a deterministic report on which AI crawlers can actually read it — robots.txt rules, edge/WAF blocks, JS-rendering blindness — plus a fix kit. No accounts, no tracking, no LLM at runtime.

Honesty note: no AI engine is documented to consume this file. We publish one
anyway because it costs nothing — but our own report labels it SPECULATIVE.

## API

- [GET /api/check?url=](https://amivisible.dev/api/check) — full visibility report (JSON, versioned)
- [GET /api/markdown?url=](https://amivisible.dev/api/markdown) — the page through an agent's eyes
- [GET /api/fixkit?url=](https://amivisible.dev/api/fixkit) — corrected robots.txt, llms.txt draft, IndexNow steps
- [POST /mcp](https://amivisible.dev/mcp) — MCP server (streamable HTTP, no auth): check_site, get_markdown, get_fix_kit
